scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/background.ts src/content.ts src/popup/index.ts src/options.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=chrome120,firefox120 --format=iife
scripts.dev: tsc --noEmit --watch & esbuild src/background.ts src/content.ts src/popup/index.ts src/options.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=chrome120,firefox120 --format=iife --watch
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && tsx scripts/package.ts chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && tsx scripts/package.ts firefox
